Lmao, peeling brassica pods. Next time leave the pods on the plant until they're almost brown and dried. If you need the planting space or live somewhere with summer rain cut the stalk off. When the pods are fully dried they will release the seeds on their own. I usually stick the pods in a paper bag to finish drying the last little bit and leave it somewhere out of direct light and good air circulation.

Once fully dried, a vigorous shake of the bag and the vast majority of the seed will be separated.

By leaving the pods on the plant until they start to dry also ensures that the seeds have matured fully.
